# SCI-NOI v0.1 r0.2 Shared Normative Module: Definitions

Module identity: `SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_DEFINITIONS v0.1/r0.2`

Status: implementation-blind Stage B draft authority; content-bound by
`SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_MODULE_BINDING v0.1/r0.2`; not owner-accepted or frozen.

## D-001. Separate operations

`NOI-GEN` generates one declared finite realization ensemble. `NOI-UNC`
infers one declared empirical uncertainty quantity from one exact admitted
ensemble. `NOI-STD` joins one immutable signal numerator to one authorized
positive uncertainty scale. No operation automatically realizes the next.

## D-002. Ordinary route

The selected ordinary route is
`NOI-GEN/PTC-TO-FROZEN-MAP-CONDITIONAL-SIGN@1`. NOI inserts one assignment
modifier at the exact PTC-to-MAP numerical boundary. MAP applies it inside
otherwise frozen accumulation. NOI owns assignment, design, realization, and
ensemble identity; MAP owns conforming application of its frozen arithmetic.

## D-003. Fixed and relearned methods

A fixed method holds every scientifically consequential adjacent state fixed
at `Theta0`. A relearned method identifies every consequential learn/resolve
stage and its member-specific `Theta_b`. Different fixed/relearned classes or
replay graphs are different ensemble identities and cannot mix.

## D-004. Coherence populations

The complete coherence population contains every stable realized
detector/channel identity in the exact observation/array parent domain. The
active design population is the subset with exact positive `beta_d` and exact
unambiguous network membership. Zero-mass, zero-total-stratum, singleton-active-
stratum, and ambiguous-membership states remain separately typed; their final
base-v0.1 design dispositions are pending owner acceptance of the complete
finite-design candidate.

## D-005. Source-bearing conditional randomization ensemble

This owner-authorized Stage B term denotes an ensemble whose fixed parent may
contain astronomical source signal, structured residuals, and source-model
error. The design balances network-local frozen pre-normalization MAP
coefficient mass. Under additional source and coverage assumptions this may
reduce some detector-common source contribution in aggregate. It does not
establish pixelwise source cancellation, a source-free null, calibrated null,
or repeated physical-noise sampling.

## D-006. Scientific replacement and execution retry

A scientific replacement changes an assignment, plan, parent, frozen operator,
or scientifically substituted member. It requires a new member and every
applicable new design/generation identity. An execution retry repeats identical
deterministic work after an infrastructure interruption. It may retain member,
assignment, parent, operator, and scientific generation only when a new
`I_attempt` records the execution and no scientific state changes.

## D-007. Initial UNC target

The initial target is the conditional detector-sign-randomization law for one
exact fixed-state parent/operator/design. Complement symmetry makes its target-
law mean zero. Its marginal second moment therefore equals its conditional-
randomization marginal variance. This is neither repeated-observation
physical-noise variance nor total MAP uncertainty.

## D-008. Common all-member domain

The initial UNC domain contains exactly the map rows where every admitted
member supplies a valid finite value under one identical member population.
Survivor, pairwise, zero-filled, interpolated, and domain-extended substitutes
are different methods and are not supplied by base v0.1.

## D-009. Covariance and rank plurality

A pointwise second moment, retained ensemble, marginal variance, fixed
projection, structured covariance, full covariance, reciprocal, precision,
and consumer weight are different product roles. `r_sign` describes the sign
design; `r_map` describes its exact projected information for a named map-
domain use. Neither count nor one rank substitutes for the other.

## D-010. Reciprocal disposition

ODQ-107 approved a finite-positive reciprocal in r0.18. r0.2 removes the
misleading active phrase "inverse ... scale" and proposes the sole successor
role `reciprocal_conditional_randomization_second_moment`. Because this changes
the approved identity/profile spelling, the r0.2 successor remains unavailable
pending the stable owner question and new immutable profile/source binding.
Inverse variance, precision, and consumer weight remain unavailable.

## D-011. Standardized product

The initial standardized product is `zeta_cond`, the exact immutable normalized
real-observation MAP signal divided by `sqrt(Vhat_cond)` on their exact
compatible finite-positive domain. Its unit is `1`. It is not uncertainty,
Gaussian/Student/pivotal/z/N-sigma significance, probability, detection,
false-alarm rate, completeness, purity, or catalog authority.

## D-012. Persistence modes

ODQ-109 authorizes three plan-selected modes: persisted ensemble, compact
deterministic regeneration, and streaming sufficient statistics. A composite
of more than one is a distinct plan. Each mode declares exact reconstruction,
numerical regeneration, retained sufficiency, unavailable later questions,
lifecycle, failure, and completion. No default or silent fallback exists.

## D-013. Profiles and Registry

GEN owns completion truth. NOI owns each named-use admission policy. SCI-VAL
binds and evaluates but authors neither. The four Stage A profile bytes are
owner-approved and exactly registered. r0.2 notation or action-byte changes
require an immutable profile/Registry successor before r0.2 evaluation; a
profile name alone is never an eligibility decision.
